REMOVE_FILE_EXT_TITLE: Remove file ext in sprites name
PREPEND_FOLDER_TITLE: Prepend folder name to file name
FIT_TO_SIZE_TITLE: Lowers the scale until every sprite fits on one texture of the max width and height. Scale is the most it will use.
BLEND_MODE_TITLE:
How the texture view and the animation player draw the sprites over the background, like an engine's blend mode (add, multiply, ...).
Only changes the preview, not the exported files.
OPTIMIZE_PNG_TITLE:
Compress the exported PNG further without losing quality.
Makes the file smaller, and the export a lot slower on big sheets. Turn it off to skip that step.
EXTRUDE_TITLE: Pads the border of the image
TIGHT_PACK_TITLE:
Searches much harder for the smallest texture: more widths, exact heights and every packer at full effort.
Usually 0-4% smaller, most on characters with big frames. Slower with many sprites.
PROJECT_OPEN_TITLE: Open a .heroic project file (Ctrl+O). You can also drop it on the image list.
PROJECT_SAVE_TITLE: Save the images, frame offsets, timing, names, character settings and options into one .heroic file (Ctrl+S)
PROJECT_EMPTY: Add some images before saving a project.
PROJECT_SAVE_ERROR: The project could not be saved: %s
PROJECT_INVALID: %s is not a Heroic Packer project.
PROJECT_NEWER: %s was saved by a newer version of Heroic Packer. Reload the page to update it.
PROJECT_REPLACE_CONFIRM: Opening %s replaces the current images and edits, which are not saved. Open it anyway?
FRAMES_NONE: No sheets or images were found.
FRAMES_DROP: Drop a png with its data file, a zip or images here
COMPARE_TITLE: See which frames changed between two versions of a sheet
COMPARE_INTRO: Load the old version as Before and the new one as After. Frames are matched by name and compared the way the game draws them, so a repack that only moved frames around the texture counts as unchanged.
COMPARE_PICK: Pick a frame to see it.
NOTESKIN_TITLE: Check that a note sheet has every animation the engine looks for
NOTESKIN_INTRO: Add a note sheet (like NOTE_assets.png with its xml), or use the frames loaded right now.
NOTESKIN_VSLICE_NOTE: V-Slice keeps notes and strums in two sheets (notes and noteStrumline), so check each one on its own. Hold notes come from NOTE_hold_assets.png, a plain image that isn't checked here.
STATS_CLASH_TITLE: Some animation prefixes also match the frames of another animation. Click to see them.
CLASH_INTRO: Psych, Codename and V-Slice find an animation's frames by prefix, so these animations also play frames that belong to another one.
CLASH_MATCHES: "%s" also picks up the frames of %s.
CLASH_SAFE_PREFIX: Fix: use "%s" as the prefix in your character file. Character files exported from here already do.
CLASH_RENAME_TITLE: Or give this animation a new name. Rename works once the new name doesn't clash.
OLD_BROWSER_MESSAGE1: Sorry, but your browser is too old for this application...
OLD_BROWSER_MESSAGE2: Use one of these recommended browsers:
BULK_OPTIMIZE_TITLE: Repack a whole folder of sheets at once with the current Pack Options
BULK_INTRO: Drop sheets, folders or zips here. Every png with a data file of the same name next to it is repacked with the current Pack Options in its own format, and you get them all back in one zip with the same folders.
BULK_LOOSE: loose pngs, packed into one sheet
BULK_DONE: Done: %s of %s sheets got smaller. Their total area went from %s to %s.
BULK_KEPT: Original kept, it was already smaller
SPLITTER_ERROR_NO_FRAMES: Sprites not found. Probably, atlas format is incorrect.
ERROR_NO_CONTEXT: No canvas context. Please, try again.
CLEAR_STORED_ORDER_TITLE: Clears the order from the repack
SPLITTER_ERROR_NO_TEXTURE: No textures found. Please, try again.
STATS_SCALE_TITLE: Shrunk from %s so every sprite fits on one %sx%s texture.
STATS_SPACE_TITLE: How much of the texture each animation takes, padding included. Click to see all of them.
STATS_SI_TITLE:
SI units (Used for ram usage stat)
Codename Engine SI = 1024
Psych 0.7+ SI = 1024
Psych 0.6 and below SI = 1000
NO_IMAGES_ERROR: Images not found. Please, add images first
CHARACTER_FILE_TITLE:
Also export a character file for the engine (Sparrow and Atlas Spritemap formats).
It lists every animation with the in-game name, fps, loop and offsets set in the Animations view.
PLAYER_PREFIX_TITLE:
Renames the animation: every frame of it gets this prefix.
Press Enter or click away to apply.
PLAYER_ANIM_NAME_TITLE:
The name the engine plays the animation by, like idle or singLEFT.
Written into the character file.
PLAYER_LOOP_TITLE: Loop the animation in game. Written into the character file.
PLAYER_OFFSET_TITLE:
Offset of the animation in game, like in the engine's character editor: a bigger X moves it left, a bigger Y moves it up.
Written into the character file.
PLAYER_GHOST_TITLE: Shows the first frame of another animation behind this one, to line them up.
PLAYER_AUTO_ALIGN_TITLE:
Sets every animation's offset so its feet line up with the idle animation, using the first frame of each.
A first pass: poses where the character jumps or crouches may need a manual tweak.
PLAYER_AUTO_ALIGN_CONFIRM: Line up every animation with %s? This replaces the offsets you already set.
PLAYER_FRAME_OFFSET_TITLE:
Moves only this frame, like editing its frameX and frameY in the xml: a bigger X moves it left, a bigger Y moves it up.
Written into the exported sheet.
PLAYER_IMPORT_CHARACTER_TITLE:
Load a Psych Engine, Codename Engine, Nightmare Vision or V-Slice character file. Its in-game names, fps, loop and offsets are matched to these frames by prefix.
Exporting the same format keeps the rest of that file.
CHARACTER_IMPORTED: Loaded %s: %s of %s animations matched these frames.
CHARACTER_IMPORT_ERROR: %s is not a character file Heroic Packer can read.
PLAYER_CONVERT_ATLAS_TITLE: Turns this texture atlas into normal frames, one animation per label, for engines that only read Sparrow sheets.
CONVERT_ATLAS_CONFIRM: Turn this texture atlas into Sparrow frames? Each label becomes an animation, the offsets set here are kept, and the spritemap pieces are replaced.
CONVERT_ATLAS_DONE: Converted into %s frames in %s animations. The export format is now Sparrow.
CONVERT_ATLAS_MISSING: These sprites were missing and were left out: %s.
CONVERT_ATLAS_ERROR: This texture atlas could not be converted.
PLAYER_TIMING_TITLE: Changes the order of this animation's frames. The frames are renumbered to match.
PLAYER_HOLD_TITLE: Shows this frame once more right after it. The copy is written into the xml again but packed only once.
STATS_REPACK_CHECK_TITLE: After the last export, every frame in the xml was compared with where it should sit: its original spot, plus any Frame offset you set.
STATS_REPACK_CHECK_EDITED: %s frames were moved on purpose with Frame offset.
REPACK_CHECK_MOVED_LIST: These frames ended up somewhere else in the exported xml: %s
RENAME_FRAME_TITLE: Double-click or press F2 to rename
RENAME_ANIMATE_ERROR: Frames of an Animate atlas can't be renamed: Animation.json refers to them by name.
FLA_NO_SYMBOLS: %s has no symbols or scenes with frames to import.
FLA_READ_ERROR: Could not read %s. Only FLA files saved by Animate or Flash CS5 and newer are supported, older ones need to be resaved.
FLA_IMPORT_SKIPPED: Nothing was imported for: %s (empty, or larger than 8192 px).
FLA_BITMAP_WARNING: %s bitmap(s) could not be decoded and were left out.
